literal_meaning: ডান হাত বাঁ হাত (right hand left hand)
figurative_meaning_en: exchange or transaction; dealing; something lost through constant passing from hand to hand
example_sentences_in_bangla: জিনিসটা ডানহাত বাঁহাত করে হারিয়ে গেছে।
বাজারে ডানহাত বাঁহাতের মধ্যে দরকষাকষি চলছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: The item got lost in the exchange of hands.
There was haggling going on through constant dealings in the market.
note: Refers to the common experience of items or money disappearing amid frequent handovers in Bengali daily life.
